purpose: Agentic QA fixtures for the Scopeify static demo. Implemented cases must be visible in the current frontend. Planned cases define next workflow coverage without pretending those capabilities exist yet.

agents.role: Checks whether the brief shows which public archives were searched, how many records were found/screened/selected, and why records were selected or excluded.
Checks whether the generated output looks like a client-facing statement of work with effort, expected outputs, timeline/window, and quote-like deliverables.
Checks whether selected local files are described as browser-side metadata scans and whether preview-level risks are surfaced.
Checks whether the page keeps the dark site theme while rendering the submitted scope as a light PDF-style document window.
Checks whether the user can understand comprehensiveness, selected evidence, excluded evidence, data availability, and the next consultation step.
Tracks planned Scopeify workflows that should become implemented fixtures once the backend/search skills exist.

cases.query: Can public transcriptomics data test whether GLP-1 receptor agonists alter reward circuitry after cocaine exposure in mouse brain?
must_find_terms: No claim that GLP-1 agonist exposure and cocaine exposure are directly represented in the same public transcriptomic cohort

cases.query: Can public tumor transcriptomics data identify biomarkers of anti-PD-1 response in melanoma patients?
Any generated Scopeify brief should include the standard consulting deliverables.
Selected local metadata should be inspected without treating the files as uploaded data.
cases.expected_decision: Preview-level risks are described in the scope.
must_find_terms: no obvious response or outcome field

cases.query: Browser-scanned table structure should be converted into a compact typed object before any backend LLM scoping review.
cases.expected_decision: The demo exposes a DataPreview bridge that the private backend can validate before Pydantic AI uses it.

cases.query: After submit, hide the intake and render the SOW in a PDF-style window without losing the dark site theme.
The generated output should make the next business action obvious.
cases.expected_decision: Consultation and spreadsheet export are visible.

cases.query: Scope a PFAS-related whole-worm C. elegans RNA-seq project with optional extra comparisons.
cases.expected_decision: Future fixture should mirror the UTEP quote structure.
cases.expected_hours: Expected to include line items and optional comparisons.

cases.query: Scope a bulk RNA-seq differential expression feasibility package.
cases.expected_decision: Future fixture should include canned bulk RNA-seq differential expression modules.
cases.expected_hours: Expected to include QC, alignment/quantification, EDA, differential expression, enrichment, and review meeting assumptions.

cases.query: Scope a single-cell RNA-seq feasibility project from public data.
cases.expected_decision: Future fixture should include canned scRNA-seq analysis modules.
cases.expected_hours: Expected to include matrix-first and raw reprocessing options.

cases.query: Scope a GWAS or polygenic risk analysis feasibility project.
cases.expected_decision: Future fixture should include cohort access, phenotype, ancestry, and QC constraints.
cases.expected_hours: Expected to include controlled-access risk and data-transfer assumptions.

cases.query: Scope a project where no suitable public data exists.
cases.expected_decision: Future fixture should return a confident no-go recommendation with transparent negative search evidence.
cases.expected_hours: Expected to be a short feasibility screen.
